name: Talanoa
summary: Privacy-first email client for macOS, Windows, Linux and Android, with a people-first inbox, unsubscribe/block tools and a Kanban for email tasks. Free plan is a real working inbox, not a trial.
description: Privacy-first email client for macOS, Windows, Linux and Android, with a people-first inbox, unsubscribe/block tools and a Kanban for email tasks. Free plan is a real working inbox, not a trial.

pricing.details: Free forever (1 email account, 2 blocks/unsubscribes per month, up to 5 Kanban tasks), no card. Pro 9 €/month or 7 €/month billed annually (80 €/year) for unlimited accounts, unlimited blocks and unsubscribes, unlimited Kanban tasks, priority support and the mobile apps, as stated.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Privacy-first email client for Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud and IMAP
People-first inbox, plus block and unsubscribe tools and a Kanban for email tasks
Apps for macOS, Windows, Linux and Android (iPhone on Pro, as stated)
The Free plan is a real working inbox, not a trial
